title: Head positions along bounded computation segments
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $(c_j)_{j\\in\\mathbb N}$ be configurations of $M$ on $x$. Suppose $N,B,H$ are natural numbers, every tape head in $c_j$ lies in $[-H,H]$ for each $j<N$, $c_N$ is halted, every tape head in $c_N$ lies in $[-(H+B),H+B]$, and for each $j<N$ there is a $u\\le B$ such that the run from $c_j$ is halted after $u$ steps or reaches $c_{j+1}$ after $u$ steps. Then, at every time $t$ and on every work tape, the head position in the run from $c_0$ lies in $[-(H+B),H+B]$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols
$(c_j)$ is a sequence of configurations on $x$
For every $j<N$, every tape head in $c_j$ lies in $[-H,H]$
Every tape head in $c_N$ lies in $[-(H+B),H+B]$
For every $j<N$, some $u\\le B$ makes the run from $c_j$ halt or reach $c_{j+1}$
